findings.issue: Phase gate only accepts review artifacts that parse as JSON, but the build-code workflow still defines facts.review.artifact_path as a durable combined Markdown report, for example workflows/build-code/SKILL.md lines 107 and 238 use `{taskDir}/{task-id}/reviews/build-code-phase-N.md`. The documented happy path therefore fails the new gate with `review artifact is not valid JSON` and then `review must include at least one readable artifact path`. This is a Spec/Standards mismatch in the review evidence data path.
findings.recommendation: Make the artifact contract executable in one direction. Recommended: document and require machine-readable review artifact paths for phase-gate input, e.g. `review.artifact_paths` pointing to raw JSON verdict files, while keeping any Markdown combined report as optional human output. Add a regression test where the documented Markdown-only `artifact_path` either passes via an explicit supported parser or is no longer documented as valid gate input.

resolutionSummary: revise_required. Targeted tests passed locally: `npm test -- tests/phase-gate.test.mjs tests/facts-subschema.test.mjs tests/verify-code-capture.test.mjs tests/receipt-verification.test.mjs` passed 95 tests; `git diff --check` passed; `node scripts/validate-stage-result.mjs build-code tasks/wh-quality-convergence/stage-result-build-code.json` passed. Blocking issue remains: phase-gate review artifact format conflicts with the build-code workflow contract.

findings.description: Spec describes or requires eliminating internal contradictions between field contracts or rule statements (cluster A: schema/contract terms + cluster B: conflict/contradiction/duplicate terms). Multiple conflicting schemas for the same entity cause silent drift — schema-drift blocking.
